title: Client Advisory Executive (Australian Migration)
company: YESTE Migration and Education Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
description:
**Job Description**

**Client Advisory Executive** – Australian Migration Sales

**Company :** YESTE Migration & Education Consulting Pvt. Ltd.

**Department :**  Sales

**Reports To** : Sales Team Leader / Sales Manager

**Location :** Kochi / Kottayam

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Lead Management & Client Engagement**

* Actively contact all assigned leads through telephone, WhatsApp, email, and virtual meetings within the defined response time.
* Ensure every assigned lead is attended to promptly without delay.
* Conduct professional consultations to understand the client's migration goals, educational background, work experience, occupation, English proficiency, and eligibility.
* Build rapport and establish trust with prospective clients through consultative selling.
* Maintain consistent communication throughout the sales journey until closure or disqualification.

**2. Sales & Conversion**

* Convert qualified enquiries into paid clients by effectively presenting YESTE's migration services.
* Achieve assigned monthly sales, revenue, and conversion targets.
* Explain YESTE's service packages, professional fees, payment schedules, and engagement process with confidence.
* Handle client objections professionally and provide appropriate solutions to maximize conversions.
* Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities where appropriate.
* Ensure a high lead-to-enrolment conversion ratio through proactive follow-up and relationship management.

**3. Australian Migration Consultation**

* Conduct preliminary eligibility assessments for Australian migration pathways.
* Explain suitable visa options based on the client's profile, including Skilled Migration, Employer Sponsored, Student, Graduate, Partner, and Family visas.
* Provide accurate information regarding:
* Skills Assessment authorities (ANMAC, ACS, VETASSESS, Engineers Australia, TRA)
* Expression of Interest (EOI)
* State Nomination
* Australian Points Test
* English language requirements (IELTS, PTE, OET)
* Escalate complex migration matters requiring legal advice to the authorised Migration Expert or Registered Migration Agent.

**4. Follow-Up & Client Relationship Management**

* Maintain a disciplined follow-up schedule for all assigned prospects.
* Ensure no qualified lead is lost due to lack of follow-up.
* Re-engage inactive or undecided clients through structured follow-up campaigns.
* Maintain long-term relationships with clients until service enrolment and beyond.
* Provide timely updates and maintain a professional client experience throughout the sales cycle.

**5. Payment Collection & Sales Documentation**

* Assist clients in completing the enrolment process.
* Coordinate and follow up on advance payments, instalments, and outstanding balances in accordance with company policy.
* Ensure all payment confirmations are properly documented and communicated to the Finance and Operations teams.
* Verify that required client documents are collected before initiating the application process.

**6. CRM Management & Reporting**

* Update Zoho CRM immediately after every client interaction.
* Record all calls, meetings, emails, WhatsApp conversations, quotations, payment status, and follow-up activities accurately.
* Maintain complete and up-to-date client records throughout the sales cycle.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly sales activity reports as required.
* Ensure data accuracy and compliance with company CRM standards.

**7. Coordination with Internal Teams**

* Coordinate with the Migration Experts, Client Application Specialists, Finance Team, and Operations Team to ensure seamless client onboarding.
* Ensure proper handover of converted clients along with complete documentation and payment details.
* Work closely with the Marketing Team by providing feedback on lead quality and campaign performance.
* Support quality assurance initiatives by maintaining documentation and communication standards.

**8. Performance Expectations (KPIs)**

The Client Advisory Executive will be expected to consistently achieve:

* Contact 100% of assigned leads within the prescribed turnaround time.
* Maintain a high outbound calling and client engagement activity every working day.
* Meet or exceed monthly sales and revenue targets.
* Achieve the expected lead-to-enrolment conversion ratio.
* Maintain regular follow-up with all active prospects until closure.
* Ensure timely collection of client payments as per agreed milestones.
* Maintain 100% CRM compliance with accurate and timely updates.
* Deliver exceptional customer service with professional communication at every stage.
* Adhere to company SOPs, compliance requirements, and ethical sales practices.
* Participate in product knowledge sessions, sales coaching, and performance review meetings.
* Demonstrate accountability, teamwork, professionalism, and a results-oriented approach at all times.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Experience:

* Migration Sales: 1 year (Required)
